'''Markos Rist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the twin brother of [[Rehanna Rist]] and a member of [[House Rist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
